abstractEnglish: For every fixed $`1\le q\le4`$, critical square-lattice random-cluster Dobrushin interfaces converge to chordal $`\mathop{\mathrm{SLE}}\nolimits _{\kappa(q)}`$, where $`\kappa(q)=4\pi/\arccos(-\sqrt q/2)`$, and the complete nested plane loop collections converge to whole-plane $`\mathop{\mathrm{CLE}}\nolimits _{\kappa(q)}`$. The results hold under uniform marked Jordan boundary approximation and retain loop multiplicities and traversals. At q = 1 we obtain Cardy's formula for square-lattice bond percolation with free boundary edges.
